note: Per-card bed map for read.html. Resolution, most specific first: stacks[stack].cards[data-card] -> stacks[stack].beats[beat] -> stacks[stack].bed -> topics[topic].beats[beat] -> topics[topic].bed -> default. Card keys are the 0-based value read.html writes into data-card; `n` inside each entry is the 1-based card number in data/stacks.json. An unresolved card HOLDS whatever is already playing. See AUDIO-CARDS.md.

basket.note: Close, dry, small. A rustle inside a container.

bath.note: Poured water in a hard, reverberant room.

battle.note: An army at middle distance. Mass, metal, low ground rumble. No voices.

coil.note: ACCENT. A low drone under a question.

copies.note: A scriptorium. Dry, papery, patient. A document being examined.

court.note: An indoor throne room. Hard marble, a low human murmur that never resolves into words.

crypt.note: Small, dead, underground. No outside at all, a slow drip, a floor rumble. Tomb, cave, cell.

dig.note: An excavation outdoors. Loose grit and soil, thin wind, sparse tool contact.

door.note: ACCENT. A shut door in near-dark. The room going quiet.

field.note: Open warm countryside. Grass, insects, a bird or two. Galilee, Kentucky, a garden.

fire.note: A large fire close by. Broad roar with irregular crackle over it.

gallery.note: A big cool room with a long tail. The room where the paintings are.

hall.note: A 19th-century wooden interior with people in it. Theatre, courthouse, meeting house.

harbour.note: Sea and gulls at dusk. Alexandria from the quay.

harbour-arrival.note: Water on hulls, mass, a crowd a quarter-mile off. A ship coming in.

letter.note: A still room, a writing hand, a tread somewhere beyond the door.

night.note: Outdoors after dark. Crickets, cool still air, one far-off dog.

palace.note: A fountain in a courtyard, cicadas beyond it. Mediterranean, hot, outdoors-but-enclosed. The Ptolemaic court.

reactor.note: A machine room. Cold, continuous, mechanical, no century.

river.note: Moving fresh water close by, reeds on the bank.

road.note: Travel on foot outdoors. Grit underfoot, wide dry air.

scroll.note: A still small interior. Nowhere in particular, which is the point.

search.note: ACCENT. The room after it was searched. The deliberate near-silence of the set.

storm.note: Rain on hard ground with distant thunder. The sky closing over.

temple.note: An enormous sacred stone interior. Vast slow air, a brazier hiss, a deep held tone.

triumph.note: A crowd in the street. The busiest bed in the set.

vault.note: A large dark stone interior with a long tail. Council chamber, cathedral, trial hall.

vials.note: A physician's table. Small glass, a pestle, careful handling.

void.note: Vast and airless. A very low sustained tone with a slow shimmer far above it. Heaven, the sky, the cosmos.

wind.note: Open, dry, outdoors, no water. Desert, steppe, hillside.
